proof.claim:
Verify that a node which leaves and returns re-registers in etcd and converges:
desired state is applied, packages are installed, and the doctor reports no
ERROR-severity findings afterwards.

WHY THIS EXISTS

On 2026-08-10 and again on 2026-08-14, Day-1 node joins failed in production
because a bundled OS dependency (libnss-resolve) pinned an exact
systemd-resolved version that the joining host did not have. The joins died at
the package-install step and the node never converged. Nothing in this suite
exercised a join, so the same break shipped twice.

This scenario closes part of that gap: it proves that a node returning to the
cluster actually reconverges rather than merely coming back up.

WHAT THIS DOES *NOT* COVER — read before trusting a green run

1. This is a REJOIN, not a fresh join. The node keeps its state directory and
   its already-installed packages, so the package-install path that actually
   broke twice is NOT exercised here. A true fresh join needs a harness action
   that does not exist yet (see "harness gap" below).

2. Containers are not hosts. The libnss-resolve class of failure is an
   interaction between a bundled .deb and the host's systemd/nsswitch layer.
   Containers share the host kernel and do not run an independent
   systemd-resolved, so this simulation CANNOT reproduce that failure mode even
   with a fresh join. That layer is covered by the pinned-VM witness
   (services/scripts/release/verify-resolver-without-libnss.sh against Ubuntu
   Noble release-20260518 / systemd 255.4-1ubuntu8.15), which is complementary
   to this scenario, not replaced by it.

So: a green run here means "a returning node reconverges". It does not mean
"joins are safe". Both statements are needed and they come from different
places.

HARNESS GAP

There is no `cluster.join_node` action, and `cluster-cold-boot` runs with
reset_before:false, so no scenario currently forces a cold install of the
release under test. `scripts/test-concurrent-join.sh` exercises joins outside
the scenario system. Adding a reset-and-join action would let this file assert
the install path directly and is the single highest-value addition to the
harness for release gating.

authority.note: Simulation output is evidence/candidate knowledge only. Governed promotion is required before production may rely on it.
